improvements: Refreshed the full mapped stadium and stand outlines.
Retained the open bowl and specialized stand collision instead of filling the playing field.
Replaced the existing 57 twelve-centimetre paint strips with exact polygon-union coverage and mip filtering, preserving their original footprints, football metadata and all non-paint geometry.

"Groapa": the bowl lies in a pit. The model is lowered 9 m (DIN_DEPTH) so only the parapet stands above the street and the top rows meet street level; the world opens its ground over the outline. Floodlight masts stand on the rim inside the mapped outline (the north-west mast stood in the Calea Floreasca car park), the scoreboard has short legs.
r9146640 (building=stadium) is now a declared replacement id: it stood as a 14 m generic wall round the bowl.
Two rendered gate pillars with a red base band flank the Sos. Stefan cel Mare access lane at OSM n11383452958.
remainingGaps: Stand heights, roof geometry and 49.5 m floodlights remain estimates; no source building heights are mapped.
Stadium redevelopment/current operational state needs date-specific confirmation.

Source-stamped native Floreasca placement/paint views and two exact-pose atlas tiles are now recorded. They retain raw scene-contact diagnostics and do not establish complete neighbour/terrain clearance, every tourist-scene placement or whole-district parity.

The 9 m depth is an estimate: OSM has no height / level / layer tag on w28212482 / r9146640, and EU-DEM 25 m under-reads a 190 m pit. The game district is flat, so the pit has a rim on all sides while the real ground north and east is as low as the pitch.
Gate pillar size and spacing are estimates; the unfinished concrete frame west of the lane has no footprint there and is not drawn.
The isolated landmark viewer draws its ground at street level, which hides a sunk bowl; these pictures are therefore in-world views of the Floreasca district.
